notableFinding.subject: opt-in bounded standing posting mandates
notableFinding.finding: The maintained operations plan already specifies the governing contract: explicit operation/book/period/account scope, currency, validity, revocation and cumulative limits, atomic shared budget reserve/consume, and that a mandate never implicitly authorizes payment, closure, signature or filing. Unattended posting under a standing mandate is already placed outside the Book Zero delivery as later scope.
notableFinding.implication: This packet needs an authorization decision before implementation, not an ownership decision. The operations plan is the maintained authority.
